summary: Iteration 10 tested the 'Reatribuir Rápido' improvement and Rafael Teste courier. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: /app/frontend/app/(lojista)/order/[id].tsx declared 'const assign' twice in the same scope (line 22 from useLocalSearchParams and line 38 as the assignment function), causing a Babel/Metro SyntaxError ('Identifier assign has already been declared') and returning HTTP 500 on the entire expo-router bundle — the whole web app was broken. Fixed by renaming the function to 'assignTo' and updating its call site (line 169). After the fix: Backend 4/4 tests pass — Rafael courier-login works, appears in /my/couriers with status=accepted, PATCH /orders/{oid}/assign-courier creates courier_offer.status=pending, and refuse sets courier_refused. Frontend: demo lojista login → queue shows 'Rafael Teste recusou — atribua a outro' banner with 'Reatribuir' button, tapping navigates to /(lojista)/order/{id}?assign=1, the ScrollView scrolls the Entregador section into view (Rafael's chip Y=154 inside 667px viewport), the temporary orange border highlight is applied, chips show 'Nome + ZF-CÓDIGO' (Carlos Moto/ZF-LBRXQ, Rafael Teste/ZF-ZMQBN, and other test couriers), and tapping a chip transitions the section text to 'Oferta enviada para X — aguardando aceite' with the chip highlighted in the brand color (verified via screenshot).
action_items: Confirm the assign→assignTo rename applied (line 38 declaration and line 169 onPress call). No other files needed edits. Consider adding an ESLint rule (no-shadow / no-redeclare) to catch same-scope const redeclarations before they reach the bundler.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (fixed by testing agent): duplicate 'assign' identifier in /app/frontend/app/(lojista)/order/[id].tsx broke the entire web bundle. Root cause: destructuring 'assign' from useLocalSearchParams on the same line as the searchParam name used for the feature, then reusing the same identifier for the assignment async function. Renamed function to 'assignTo'.
app/(lojista)/order/[id].tsx is 279 lines — still manageable, no split needed yet.
The order detail screen polls every 4000ms via setInterval → each poll refetches order + chat + couriers. Fine for now, but consider debounce/backoff if the store has many active orders.
queue.tsx testID for the card is on the outer <View> but the Pressable that navigates is nested — noted in previous iterations, non-blocking.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/(lojista)/order/[id].tsx (renamed inner function 'assign' → 'assignTo' at declaration and onPress call to resolve duplicate const declaration syntax error)
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST order (assigned to Rafael, refused by Rafael) so the 'courier_refused' banner + Reatribuir button appear in the demo lojista queue for the UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After the fix, the web bundle compiles again (HTTP 200 on entry.bundle). To reproduce the refused state for UI, POST /orders as cliente, PATCH /orders/{oid}/assign-courier with Rafael (99988877766 → ZF-ZMQBN), then POST /orders/{oid}/offer-response {accept:false} with Rafael's token. The queue-reassign-<oid> button is inside the refused banner in queue.tsx; tapping it navigates to /(lojista)/order/<id>?assign=1 and the [id] screen reads the 'assign' search param and calls scrollRef.scrollTo({y: courierY.current - 12}) with a 2.5s brand-color border highlight (styles.courierBoxHi). Alert.alert('Oferta enviada ✅') renders inline in RN Web — assert on the visible state text 'Oferta enviada para X — aguardando aceite' rather than dialog events.
rca_of_issue: The 'Reatribuir Rápido' change added ?assign=1 support by destructuring 'assign' from useLocalSearchParams (line 22). However the file already had a local function named 'assign' (the courier assignment handler on line 38). Two const declarations of the same identifier in the same block is a SyntaxError in ES modules — Babel reported: 'Identifier assign has already been declared. (38:8)'. Metro returned HTTP 500 for /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle → the whole web preview showed a blank page (raw text extraction was empty). Fix: renamed the function to 'assignTo' (line 38 declaration + line 169 onPress). Bundle recovered, feature works end-to-end (verified via UI screenshots and 4/4 backend tests).
